svg.title: Map of the hephaestus commands
svg.desc: The hephaestus commands grouped by job. Set up: world register, genome register, arena manifest, artifact put, verifier. Run once: run, submit, job status, job kill, evaluate. Compare: arena evaluate, arena select, arena invariants. Improve: forge analyze, genome propose, genome assess, evolve start. Crown: champion seed, champion promote, champion rollback, champion show. Roll out safely: drift record, canary start, canary advance, canary live-check. Reuse what works: gene extract, gene transfer, gene record, gene speciate. Stay in control: status, freeze / unfreeze, kill --all, replay, daemon stop.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every command, grouped by what it's for

svg.text: Each one is typed after hephaestus, for example: hephaestus arena evaluate
